expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the heading text is rendered in a very light, washed-out color that is actually fainter and harder to read than the smaller subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10') beneath it, producing insufficient contrast against the pale green background.

The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently between cards: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare outline heart on the image, while the pizza card shows the same heart inside a dark circular background.

On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the delivery information is duplicated: an '€0 delivery' pill badge appears on the image and '€0 delivery' is repeated again in the metadata line ('25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen').

expected.reasoning: Both describe unreadable light heading text on pale green promo banner.
